title: MAiBest - Multiperspective analysis of patient portal use over time - based on the example of digital anamnesis in a best-practice hospital
summary: The Hospital Future Act requires all German hospitals to implement patient portals by 2025 that enable "a digital exchange of information between service providers and service recipients" (KHZG, Section 19 (1) No. 2). A central tool of the patient portals is the digital anamnesis. This must be used equally by both patients and physicians in order to realize its potential for improving care. However, the example of the electronic medical record has shown in the past that such digital innovations are not necessarily used. The aim is therefore to identify possible factors that have an influence on the use of the patient portal or possible barriers to use or reasons for non-use. Standardized surveys and qualitative interviews are conducted for this purpose.
conditions: The study examines which factors influence the use of a patient portal and whether these factors change over time.

interventions.name: Patients are surveyed in a standardized threefold cross-section (pre-post-post) regarding the use of a patient portal. In addition, patients are interviewed in a twofold cross-section (post-post) regarding barriers to the use of a patient portal.

Physicians are surveyed in a standardized threefold cross-section (pre-post-post) regarding the use of a patient portal. In addition, physicians are interviewed in a twofold cross-section (post-post) regarding barriers to the use of a patient portal.
Possible effects of using the patient portal on the quality of documentation and treatment are exploratively examined using anamnesis documents and administrative data

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients who receive inpatient or outpatient treatment in the three participating wards and physicians who work in the three participating wards
Exclusion criteria:
Age under 18 years
Missing declaration of consent
